text:
Mia (Marketing): quick heads-up — SolarGrid said yes to a case study. want to align on interview + quote capture this week.
Sam (Content Lead): amazing! do we have a primary contact and a short success metric we can lead with?
Kate (Customer Success): primary is Lina Torres (Supply Ops). she mentioned: 40% inference cost reduction and 2x throughput on peak. can confirm exact phrasing after call.
Mia (Marketing): perfect. Lina is available wed or thu afternoon (PDT). can we do 30 min remote interview + ask for a short written quote they can approve?
Oliver (Design Lead): 30 min works. i can prep a 1-slide visual of before/after numbers + 3 pull quotes. need the numbers by tuesday EOD to design.
Sam (Content Lead): draft interview q's below — please thumbs up / edit: 1) what was your setup before Redwood? 2) what problem were you solving? 3) what results did you measure? 4) favorite part of the migration? 5) quote approval line.
Amelia (PR): as soon as we have a quote we'll send a testimonial release. legal will need to sign off on quote wording if it references specific %s.
LegalBot: Reminder: any customer quote mentioning metrics or cost savings requires a short release form. attach draft release to thread before publishing.
Kate (Customer Success): i'll ask Lina to allow: (a) a 1-sentence public quote, (b) permission to publish the slide with anonymized numbers, (c) approval for webinar co-presenting opt-in.
Jorge (Product): would also like to collect a short architecture diagram from them — can the interview include one screenshot of their infra?
Mia (Marketing): schedule options i propose: Wed 3:00pm PDT / Wed 5:30pm PDT / Thu 2:00pm PDT. Lina preferred wed afternoon so let's push for 3:00. can someone own calendar invite + link?
Oliver (Design Lead): i'll send calendar invite once content q's are final.
Sam (Content Lead): i've drafted a short email to Lina to get the quote and confirm time. dropping below — please edit inline: 
```
Hi Lina — thanks for agreeing to the case study. can we confirm wed 3pm PDT for a 30-minute interview? we'll ask a few background q's and capture a one-sentence quote for our site. we'll share the release form afterwards for your legal team's review. best, Mia + Redwood team
```
Mia (Marketing): minor edit: add "we can anonymize any figures if needed".
Amelia (PR): legal wants the first pass on the release language. kate, once you have the quote text, ping legal or paste here. LegalBot: you can use this template: https://redwood.internal/templates/testimonial-release-v2 (automated).
Kate (Customer Success): pinged Lina. she replied: "wed 3pm works. can you share the list of q's and the release form ahead of time?"
Sam (Content Lead): replied to Lina with q's + asked for preferred phrasing for cost reduction metric.
Mia (Marketing): next: webinar? SolarGrid expressed interest in a joint webinar if the case study goes well. shortlist topics: "reducing inference cost at scale" or "predictable LLM throughput for ops teams". thoughts?
Jorge (Product): "reducing inference cost at scale" resonates with their execs. also suggest a 30-min joint talk + 15-min q&a.
Oliver (Design Lead): timeline check: if interview is wed and we get quote by fri, we can draft case study + slide by next wednesday. want to align on webinar date in 3 weeks to give customer time to approve assets.
Amelia (PR): i'll draft the webinar abstract and co-presenter bullets. need confirmation whether SolarGrid wants logo + speaker bios.
Mia (Marketing): action items: (1) Kate confirm quote and permission for release (owner: Kate) (2) Sam finalize interview questions + email (owner: Sam) (3) Oliver send invite + mock slide after numbers (owner: Oliver) (4) Legal to prepare release template once quote text is posted (owner: Legal) (5) Amelia draft webinar abstract if customer opts in (owner: Amelia).
Kate (Customer Success): i'll update thread when Lina approves quote wording.
LegalBot: note for team — if final quote mentions specific % reductions, attach customer's signed release before publishing and route to privacy@redwood.com.
Mia (Marketing): thanks all. tiny ask — can someone from product join the interview for a 10-min tech section? Jorge?
Jorge (Product): happy to join.
Oliver (Design Lead): adding brief checklist for the interview: 1) consent for recording 2) ask for exact metric phrasing 3) request 1-2 screenshots 4) confirm speaker names/titles.
Sam (Content Lead): i'll bring a short preamble and the five questions.
Mia (Marketing): ok locking wed 3pm. i'll send a short pre-interview agenda to Lina after lunch.
Kate (Customer Success): Lina confirmed via DM: "we approve the quote: 'SolarGrid reduced inference costs by ~40% and doubled peak throughput after moving to Redwood Inference.' we also agree to the release form." i'll paste the exact signed quote once i have the pdf.
Mia (Marketing): fantastic — thanks kate. once we have pdf i'll drop it to legal and then we can publish the case study + plan webinar. :tada:
Amelia (PR): noted — will prepare a press-ready blurb and webinar abstract draft.
LegalBot: received signed release (placeholder). route to privacy@redwood.com for records.
Mia (Marketing): closing loop — Oliver will design assets; Sam will write; Amelia will prep webinar; Kate will deliver signed release; Jorge will join interview. follow-ups nudges thursday morning if quote not in. :thumbsup:
